accounting: Initial stationary inactive legs may be left-truncated at simulation start; raw activity is unchanged

assumptions.driver_coefficients: illustrative existing Phase 3 values, not calibrated from TLC
assumptions.spatial_mapping: provided network-zone centroids; intrazonal trips excluded and counted
assumptions.demand_universe: recorded completed trips, not all attempted/cancelled marketplace requests
assumptions.fleet: training occupied interval proxy divided by assumed utilization; not observed driver counts

runs.unavailable_reason: Trip records omit unserved requests and fleet online exposure; proxy request times do not identify observed waits
runs.comparison_population: All sampled held-out recorded trips; simulated wait/ride means are conditional on simulated service
